title: Microbiota Modulation and Odor Emission in Bacterial Ecology
summary: This cluster revolves around the relationship between microbiota, odorous compounds, and bacterial ecology. Microbiota is affected by Magnolol, which in turn modulates its effects on Soybean oligosaccharide and Stachyose. Meanwhile, dietary protein levels influence the production of odorous compounds, which negatively impact bacterial ecology. The presence of pig manure is also linked to bacterial ecology, suggesting a complex interplay between these entities in the context of microbiota modulation and odor emission.
